operations.description:
Search available services.

When no filter is specified, returns all accessible services. For
authenticated users, also returns all services the calling user has
"servicemanagement.services.bind" permission for.
operations.T: [METHOD] get [NAME] serviceuser services search [PATH] services search [PARAMS] access alt bearer callback fields key oauth page pp pretty print protocol quota size token type upload user xgafv [SCHEMA] published response search service services

operations.description: List enabled services for the specified consumer.

operations.description:
Disable a service so it can no longer be used with a
project. This prevents unintended usage that may cause unexpected billing
charges or security leaks.

Operation<response: google.protobuf.Empty>
operations.T: [METHOD] post [NAME] serviceuser projects services disable [PATH] name disable [PARAMS] access alt bearer callback fields key name oauth pp pretty print protocol quota token type upload user xgafv [SCHEMA] disable operation request service
